repo_notes.content: This repository is the workspace for the Cognition challenge. The most important content is docs/demo-repo-selection.md, which records the criteria, candidates, exclusions and recommendation for choosing a public repository for the customer demo. Write wiki pages in Japanese and reproduce the tables from that document faithfully, including all numbers and links.
